source.title: Duskwood Mission VII: Recover Shadowscythe
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Shadowscythe and deliver it to me.
source.objective: Recover the Shadowscythe in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion upstairs in the farmhouse at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
